Execute the acquired semantic reading operations on the CURRENT
source windows. All operation meanings, alternatives and examples are learned
assets, not current-source facts. Classify the operation's actual question;
do not answer a downstream task or copy an old example's choice. Preserve who
acts, the legal modality, trigger, scope and qualifications. A heading, mention
or hypothetical event is not automatically an operative duty or permission.
Return exactly one answer for every supplied query ID. Select a declared choice
or "unknown". Missing information is unknown, never an implicit negative.
Return {"answers": {query_id: {"choice": choice, "evidence_unit_ids": [unit_id]}}}.
Select the IDs of the current supplied units that support your classification.
The host retrieves those units exactly. Do not copy, rewrite or repair quotes.
Select all units needed to resolve actors, conditions and cross-references.
Every definite classification needs supporting units. Only an explicitly
declared alternative meaning absence after inspecting the complete supplied
source may have no supporting unit. Unknown may have no evidence. Demonstration
quotes belong to their original sources, never the current source. No extra IDs
or fields. Selecting a unit does not make its interpretation automatically true.

{"operations": [{"choices": [{"meaning": "窗口明示接收者须具有 need-to-know。", "name": "need_to_know_required"}, {"meaning": "完整供应窗口没有陈述 need-to-know 条件；只判断该窗口。", "name": "need_to_know_not_stated_in_window"}], "examples": [], "name": "need_to_know_requirement_v1", "question": "判断供应披露窗口是否明示接收者必须具有 need-to-know；不得从必要目的或一般保密义务推断。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“The Confidential Information may be disclosed only to employees or contractors of the Recipient with a “need to know” who are subject to written confidentiality agreements sufficient to carry out the intent of this Agreement.”→need_to_know_required；“The Receiving Party shall take all practical steps to keep the Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information confidential and shall restrict access to the Confidential Information to those agents and professional advisers to whom disclosure is necessary in pursuit of the Approved Purpose.”→need_to_know_not_stated_in_window。"}], "current_queries": [{"id": "disclosure_need_to_know_requirement_v1__11_18", "operation": "need_to_know_requirement_v1", "unit_ids": [11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18], "current_units": [{"id": 11, "text": "(a) is hereby acknowledged by CONSULTANT to be of a proprietary nature to, and to constitute secrets of NYNEX;"}, {"id": 12, "text": "(b) shall not be copied, used, distributed, disclosed, disseminated or communicated in any way or form by CONSULTANT whether or not for its own benefit, to anyone outside or within its own organization, except on a \"need-to-know\" basis to the extent necessary for:"}, {"id": 13, "text": "(i) negotiations, discussions and consultations with personnel or authorized representatives of NYNEX;"}, {"id": 14, "text": "(ii) supplying NYNEX with products or services at its order;"}, {"id": 15, "text": "(iii) preparing bids, estimates and proposals for submission to NYNEX; and"}, {"id": 16, "text": "(iv) any other purpose which NYNEX may authorize in writing;"}, {"id": 17, "text": "(c) shall not be used by CONSULTANT for any purposes other than those set forth herein, without the experts prior written permission of NYNEX;"}, {"id": 18, "text": "(d) shall be held by CONSULTANT in the strictest confidence, and shall be treated by it with the same degree of care to avoid disclosure to any third party as is used with respect to CONSULTANT'S own information of like importance, or, a minimum, shall be treated with a reasonable degree of care to avoid any such disclosure."}]}, {"id": "disclosure_need_to_know_requirement_v1__28_30", "operation": "need_to_know_requirement_v1", "unit_ids": [28, 29, 30], "current_units": [{"id": 28, "text": "(e) is disclosed by CONSULTANT to a third party, with the express prior written permission of NYNEX;"}, {"id": 29, "text": "(f) is disclosed by CONSULTANT in order to satisfy any legal requirement of any competent government body; provided, however, that immediately upon CONSULTANT's receipt of any such request, CONSULTANT shall first advise NYNEX of same before making any disclosure to such body, so that NYNEX may either interpose an objection to such disclosure before such body, or take action to assure confidential handling of the Confidential Information by such body, or take other action to protect the Confidential Information which NYNEX deems appropriate under the circumstances; or"}, {"id": 30, "text": "(g) in any event, five (5) years after the date of execution of this Non-Disclosure Agreement."}]}]}
